title: Evaluate components and data flows
description:
Purpose: Grade the map. Component gold uses identity type:name plus span evidence. Data-flow gold uses source, target, and flow type. Plexus evaluate accuracy is how we run those scorecards. The CLI component harness and PR #16 proposed notes are not a Plexus scorecard.

Definition of done: stories for Plexus component and data-flow accuracy; a task to add proposed data_flows annotation packets.
